experiment: Experiment 007 - GLM-5.3 PD disaggregation with AMD monokernels on MI355X

agentx_l1.csv.what: AgentX L1 (900 s) result per run; fresh servers per run
agentx_l1.csv.rows: one completed run; a -r2 suffix is a rerun of a failed attempt, -aa a replicate

fields.arm: mono = agg + monokernel; base = agg; pd = PD without decode radix; pdr = PD + decode radix; pdk = pdr + decode monokernel; dp2mono = mono on two nodes behind one router
fields.gpus: every GPU of the deployment; tok_s_per_gpu divides by it
fields.intvty_p50 / intvty_p90: client per-request 1/TPOT (tok/s/user); p90 is the slow tail
fields.e2e_norm_intvty_p90: InferenceX's E2E-normalized interactivity at P90 (the dashboard's default AgentX x axis)
fields.window_request_errors: request errors inside the measurement window

files.gsm8k.csv: GSM8K strict-match, 1319 questions, concurrency 2, real MTP acceptance; exact two-sided McNemar against agg without monokernels
files.decode_batch_sizes.csv: running requests per decode step, sampled every 40 steps from the TP0 decode log; the monokernel covers steps of at most 2 requests (8 rows)
files.inferencex_published.csv: published GLM-5.3 MI355X AgentX rows from inferencex.semianalysis.com /api/v1/benchmarks?model=GLM-5.2 joined with /api/v1/derived-agentic-metrics (3600-s official runs)
files.width12_kernel_checks.csv: test/kernels/glm53/check_layer.py at 12 rows on random weights, 8 GPUs, with the width-12 work in progress
